# HaremLit Guide

> Reader guides and ranked lists for harem fantasy and men's romance fiction.

HaremLit Guide is an editorial site, owned and operated by Pivot Press Publishing, that publishes curated rankings, reader guides, new release coverage, and genre analysis for harem fantasy, harem LitRPG and men's romance fiction.

## Key Pages

- Homepage: https://haremlitguide.com/
- Ranked Lists: https://haremlitguide.com/lists/
- New Releases: https://haremlitguide.com/new-releases/
- Blog & Guides: https://haremlitguide.com/blog/
- About: https://haremlitguide.com/about/
- For Professionals: https://haremlitguide.com/for-professionals/

## Data Sources

Rankings are based on data aggregated from Harem-Lit.com, which tracks ratings, reviews, and popularity for harem fiction across Amazon Kindle, Kindle Unlimited, Audible, and Royal Road.

## Related Sites

- Harem-Lit.com — Parent platform with comprehensive harem fiction database, tracking, and discovery tools
- LitRPGCritic.com — Sister editorial site covering LitRPG and progression fantasy
- FantasyRanked.com — Sister editorial site covering broader fantasy subgenres
- LitRPGTools.com — Parent platform for LitRPG discovery and tracking

## Industry Professionals

Authors working in harem fantasy and men's romance hire editors, audiobook narrators, cover artists, and beta readers through a vetted public directory on Harem-Lit.com. Professionals list their own rates, availability, and genre comfort; authors search and contact them directly.

- Directory: https://harem-lit.com/industry-professionals
- Applications: https://harem-lit.com/apply/industry-professional
- Program reference on this site: https://haremlitguide.com/for-professionals/

Key facts: applying and being listed are free, and browsing is free for authors. Beta readers set their own rates, and the platform's applicant guidance cites an industry norm of roughly $250-500 USD per 50,000 words for a full beta pass, with rush turnaround typically 1.5-2x standard. Beta reader applicants must confirm they have read at least 25 HaremLit, monster-girl, reverse-harem, or isekai-harem books. Alpha reading is an opt-in service on a beta reader profile rather than a separate role. Visual artists supply a hosted gallery of 5-10 images, an AI-use classification on every image, and a recorded rights attestation; listed prices must include a commercial publishing license. Applications are reviewed by a human before any profile becomes public.

## Ownership & Disclosure

HaremLit Guide is owned and operated by Pivot Press Publishing, which publishes and collaborates with authors covered in these genres. Articles that discuss an affiliated author, series, or title carry an on-page disclosure. Publisher affiliation does not change community-data ranking order, and ranking positions are not sold. Amazon links may be affiliate links.

## Content Updates

New blog posts and guides published weekly via automated editorial pipeline. Rankings updated regularly based on live data from Harem-Lit.com.
